name: Struggling
overview: Scripture reveals that struggling and suffering are integral to the Christian experience, producing patience and spiritual growth as believers endure trials (Romans 5:3). Though present sufferings are real, they are temporary and incomparable to the future glory God promises (Romans 8:18). Christians are empowered to face all challenges through the strength Christ provides (Philippians 4:13), and are called to love one another as Christ loved them, reflecting His presence among His people (John 15:12; Revelation 21:3). This hope and divine companionship sustain believers amid their struggles.
